Shitet Apartament 2+1+2+1 Depo Tek Kompleksi Bermon
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 Jug-lindje full diell dhe drite ,organizimi Apartamentit eshte hyrje koridor ne te majte depo lavanteri,hekurosje +magazinim ,ngjitur njera dhome gjumi ne te djathte salloni ndenjes+kuzhine,ne vazhdim te djathte dhoma gjumit tjeter me tualet te brendesesh para koridor te vogel,e vecanta keti apartamenti eshte organazimi ku dhomat e gjumit jan totalisht te ndara nga njera tjetra ,si dhe ballkoni madhe qe bashkon dhomen e gjumit me sallon ne nje hapsire te shfrytezueshme me xham dhe drite ,sic edhe shikohet ne fotot Apartamenti eshte i gjithi ne diell gjat gjith dites ku kursimi ngrohjes dhe ndicimit eshte i pa nevoijshem,Cka e ben akoma me cilesor kete apartament jan 2 tualetet me dritare natyrale,qe eshte thuajse e pamundur per te gjetur..
Pallati ku ndodhet Apartamenti eshte 6 katesh 5 hyrje ne kat me ashensor ,ndertim i vitevete 2025 me fasad te ventiluar ,xhama super izolim termik dhe akustik i fjales se fundit ,apartmanti eshte lene ne faze zgjedhje te parketit ,dyerve etj..
Apartamenti eshte i gateshem per banim ,mundesi parkimi si jasht dhe -1 me cmim ekstra
Per me shum info me kontaktoni
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2+1 Depot in the Bermon Complex
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1+2+1 Depot in the Bermon Complex The apartment is located on the 4th floor South-east full of sun and light, the organization of the apartment is the entrance corridor on the left, laundry room, ironing + storage, one bedroom attached to the right, the living room + kitchen, next to the right another bedroom with an indoor toilet in front of a small corridor, the special thing about this apartment is the organization where the bedrooms they are completely separate from each other, as well as the large balcony that joins the bedroom with the living room in a usable space with glass and light, as seen in the photos. The apartment is all in the sun all day long, where saving heating and lighting is unnecessary. What makes this apartment even better are the 2 bathrooms with natural windows, which is almost impossible to find.. The building where the apartment is located has 6 floors, 5 floor entrances with an elevator, built in 2025 with a ventilated facade, super thermal and acoustic insulation glass of the last word, the apartment is left in the stage of choosing the parquet, doors, etc.. The apartment is ready for living, the possibility of parking outside and -1 at an extra price. For more information, contact me.
